data: What is the value on the y-axis for the blue dashed line with stars at a vocabulary size of 1e+06?

The y-axis represents the average out-of-vocabulary (OoV) rate across all users, and the x-axis represents the vocabulary size in log scale. The blue dashed line with stars corresponds to one of the test sets collected on a specific Tuesday. At a vocabulary size of 1e+06, the y-axis value for this line appears to be approximately 0.025.
